text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and 429 spike observed outbound from gateway cluster (us-west-2). Affected route: /v1/generate. Error mix: 502 gateway, 504 timeouts, 429 from rate-limiter. Paging oncall. pd:PD-9821 :rotating_light:

oncall-anna: On it, I'm pulling up dashboards. Noticed increase starting ~1772301000. Can you drop the error sample logs?

sanjay: Pasting a short tail of the gateway logs: ```
2026-03-14T14:05:03Z gateway-01 ERROR req_id=abc123 upstream=backend-1:502 "Bad Gateway" attempts=3
2026-03-14T14:05:04Z gateway-02 WARN req_id=def456 upstream=ratelimiter:429 "quota_exceeded" quota_id=global_tier
2026-03-14T14:05:12Z gateway-01 ERROR req_id=ghi789 upstream=backend-1:504 "ReadTimeout"
```

maria: I pushed a quota override to the global rate-limiter last night to enforce new per-customer quotas for cost control (change: set default_tps=10 -> 2 for non-paid). Could that be blocking bursty proxies?

kai: If default_tps is too low, clients' retries could be spiking the gateway and then causing backpressure on the backend -> 502/504 cascade. Are we seeing retry storms?

john: Yes, histogram shows client retries per request went from 1.1 -> 3.7 after 14:05. Many clients interpret 429 as immediate retry. No Retry-After header set on limiter right now.

oncall-anna: Let's take quick mitigation steps: 1) temporary relax global_tps to previous value, 2) add Retry-After header to rate-limiter responses (60s), 3) enable emergency autoscale on dedicated pool for customers seeing errors. I'll coordinate.

maria: Rolling back override now to default_tps=10 (rollback id: cfg-2026-0314-01). Pushing to rate-limiter cluster with canary 20%.

ops-bot: cfg-2026-0314-01 deploy started -> canary hosts: rl-canary-1, rl-canary-2.

oncall-anna: Kai, please take DB/backend scaling if needed. Sanjay, watch gateway error rates and trace IDs. Emma-cs, please prepare a customer-facing note saying we're investigating unexpected 5xx/429s and mitigation in progress.

emma-cs: Drafting now: "We’ve identified elevated errors impacting some API requests; mitigation underway. Will follow up with timeline and affected customers." Sending to #customer-success for quick review.

ops-bot: canary deploy health: rl-canary-1 OK, rl-canary-2 OK. Propagating to 100% (deploy id cfg-2026-0314-01).

sanjay: After rollback, we're seeing a drop in 429s on the limiter but gateway 502/504s are still elevated from backlog. Error rate: 5xx peaked at 17% (was 2% baseline) now 7% and trending down.

kai: Started adding two extra backend workers to dedicated pool (scale +2 instances). Monitoring latency.

john: Also applied a temporary global-client-throttle: reject requests with >20 concurrent streams per connection to reduce head-of-line. This should stop some abusive clients.

oncall-anna: Good. We're replacing blind retries client-side with Retry-After header so retries should be better behaved. Ops, estimate time to normal: 15-25 min if trend continues.

maria: Note — root cause: misapplied quota change to the global tier that included some high-volume customers under the non-paid profile. The config logic matched the wrong label (label precedence bug). Creating follow-up PR to fix label resolution.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-9821 acknowledged by oncall-anna.

pagerduty-bot: PD-9821 status -> acknowledged by oncall-anna at 2026-03-14T14:07:02Z.

emma-cs: Sending interim customer note: "We're seeing higher error rates and timeouts. We've rolled back a quota config, scaled capacity, and added retry guidance (Retry-After). If you continue to see issues, please DM support with request IDs." :email:

oncall-anna: Handoff: I need to grab lunch. Kai, can you own the active mitigation for the next 90 minutes? I'll remain reachable.

kai: Taking over. Monitoring link: https://console.redwood/internals/metrics?alert=PD-9821. I'll escalate to SRE if errors >10% for >5 minutes.

john: Adding a temporary WAF rule to block a small set of client IPs showing extreme retry loops. WAF rule id waf-tempo-0314-01.

ops-bot: WAF rule waf-tempo-0314-01 applied -> blocked 12 IPs (mostly from single ASN).

sanjay: Post-mitigation snapshot: 429s back to baseline, 5xx at ~3.1% and falling. Average latency back to SLO for most routes. Trace sample shows queue depth normalized.

oncall-anna: Thanks team. Root-cause action items: (1) fix label precedence in quota selection (maria), (2) add Retry-After default on limiter (sanjay), (3) improve canary safety checks for quota changes (eng-platform), (4) customer postmortem and timeline (emma-cs + product).

maria: Filed bug and PR: GH-4521 "quota label precedence leads to misassignment of global_tier". Will include a test and rollout guard.

kai: I'll keep monitoring for the next hour and close PD if stable. Current impact estimate: ~8% of requests experienced elevated errors at peak; around 6 customers reported degraded performance. No data exfiltration.

incident-bot: PD-9821 -> update: mitigations applied, monitoring. Will auto-close if error rate <1.5% for 30m.

oncall-anna: Back from lunch, thanks for taking over. Keep me posted.

kai: Will do. Closing thread for now, will post timeline and final impact summary in ~24h. :white_check_mark:
